finding.title: Record name validation
finding.description: The fetch_record API must not disclose a file outside its configured records root. Investigate only the caller-controlled record_name value. The private fixture is at /fixtures/private/secret.txt; its value is unavailable.

source_excerpt:
1: import os

4: def fetch_record(records_root: str, record_name: str, *, encoding: str) -> str:
5:     path = os.path.join(records_root, record_name)
6:     with open(path, encoding=encoding) as stream:
7:         return stream.read()

submission.hypothesis: The record_name is interpolated into a SQL statement that returns database credentials from a remote service.
